rankings.title: University rankings
reason.budget-mismatch: Your budget does not match the fee for this programme.
reason.contextual-offer: A contextual offer may apply; the standard offer alone does not settle this.
reason.degree-unverified: Your degree subject could not be verified from the profile as entered.
reason.fee-residency-unknown: The fee depends on your residency / tuition-grant status, which was not provided.
reason.gaokao-no-equivalence: No official Gaokao equivalence is published for this programme, so the academic requirement cannot be judged from a Gaokao score.
reason.igp-not-threshold: The Indicative Grade Profile describes admitted students; it is not a minimum threshold.
reason.missing-info: Information needed for this check was not provided.
reason.missing-test-date: A test score was supplied without a test date, and the threshold depends on the date.
reason.no-english-level: The course page states no English language level for this programme.
reason.no-equivalence: No official equivalence is published for this qualification, so the academic requirement cannot be judged.
reason.no-rejection-rule: The official page states no rejection rule for a missing or low score, so this cannot be marked as not met.
reason.no-threshold: The test is required, but the official page states no score threshold.
reason.toefl-instead: TOEFL was supplied instead of IELTS; it is assessed under its own rule.
reason.toefl-scale-unknown: The TOEFL score cannot be judged without a test date, because the scoring scale changed on 21 Jan 2026.
reason.usa-ap-general-only: The AP grades meet Imperial's general minimum standard, but the course-specific requirement (A* in Mathematics) cannot be checked from AP grades alone.
reason.usa-no-equivalence: No official US (SAT/ACT/AP) equivalence is published for this programme, so the academic requirement cannot be judged from US qualifications.
